title: A Control-Theoretic Approximation to Predictive Coding Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2611.26319v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Backpropagation remains the dominant method for training deep neural networks, but its reliance on non-local computations has motivated the search for biologically plausible alternatives. Two prominent frameworks, predictive coding (PC) and deep feedback control (DFC), offer distinct approaches to local learning, yet their relationship remains unclear. Here, we show that DFC arises as a local approximation to predictive coding dynamics near fixed points, with exact equivalence in shallow linear networks and systematic deviations arising with depth, nonlinearity, and distance from equilibrium. We characterize how this approximation, which we call Approx PC, deviates from PC in its activity dynamics, and show that these deviations can be mitigated by relinearizing the feedback controller and approaching the output target through a sequence of intermediate nudges. translated_title: 预测编码动力学的控制论近似
translated_abstract: 反向传播仍然是训练深度神经网络的主流方法，但其对非局部计算的依赖促使研究者寻找生物学上合理的替代方案。预测编码与深度反馈控制这两个著名框架为局部学习提供了不同的途径，但二者之间的关系尚不明确。本研究表明，DFC 是预测编码动力学在不动点附近的局部近似：在浅层线性网络中二者完全等价，而随着网络深度增加、非线性的引入以及偏离平衡点距离的增大，会产生系统性偏差。我们对这种近似（称为 Approx PC）在活动动力学方面偏离 PC 的方式进行了刻画，并证明可以通过对反馈控制器重新线性化以及通过一系列中间推动逐步逼近输出目标来减轻这些偏差。在 MNIST 和 FashionMNIST 数据集上训练的网络中，Approx PC 达到了（与其他方法相当的）任务性能（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文证明了深度反馈控制（DFC）是预测编码（PC）动力学在不动点附近的局部近似（称为 Approx PC），在浅层线性网络中二者完全等价，且通过重新线性化反馈控制器和分步逼近输出目标可以缓解由深度和非线性带来的偏差，从而厘清了两种生物学可信局部学习框架之间的关系。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that deep feedback control (DFC) is a local approximation of predictive coding (PC) dynamics near fixed points—exactly equivalent in shallow linear networks—and that the deviations of this approximation (Approx PC) can be mitigated by relinearizing the feedback controller and approaching the output target through a sequence of intermediate nudges.
